about.title: About GOLTENS General Supplies
about.description: GOLTENS General Supplies is an Egyptian general-supplies and procurement company. We supply products and equipment according to customer specifications, BOQs and project or tender requirements.
profileParagraphs: GOLTENS General Supplies supplies industrial equipment and general supplies to organizations in Egypt. Each request is handled against the requirement the customer provides — a technical specification, a BOQ, an equipment list or a project or tender requirement.

Our scope is organized into published procurement sectors, from industrial equipment and fire protection to electrical equipment, healthcare supplies, construction materials and general supplies. Each sector page describes its scope of supply.
about.processIntro: A document-driven process, from your requirement to supply.

processSteps.title: Requirement
processSteps.description: You send the requirement — item description, specification, BOQ or equipment list, quantity and delivery location.

processSteps.title: Document & Specification Review
processSteps.description: We review the information you provide and ask for anything missing that is needed to define the items.

processSteps.title: Sourcing
processSteps.description: We source items that match the stated requirement — or, where you accept one, a technically suitable alternative.

processSteps.title: Quotation
processSteps.description: You receive a quotation prepared against your stated requirement, showing the offered items, availability and lead time.

processSteps.title: Supply
processSteps.description: Once the order is confirmed, the items are supplied as agreed in the quotation. Final technical acceptance remains with the customer or consultant, where applicable.

about.missionText: To respond to procurement requirements with clear quotations, source items according to the stated specifications, and carry out supply in a practical, organized way.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: GOLTENS GENERAL SUPPLIES ("GOLTENS," "we," "us," or "our") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect through this website, how we use it, and the choices you have.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect the information you provide directly to us — such as your name, company name, email address, phone number, and project details — when you submit a request for quotation, complete a contact form, or otherwise communicate with us. We do not require you to create an account or provide payment information to use this website.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use the information you provide to respond to your inquiry, prepare and deliver quotations, communicate about your project, and improve the services we offer. We do not use your information for automated decision-making or unsolicited marketing.

sections.heading: How We Share Your Information
sections.body: We do not sell your personal information. We may share it with the manufacturers or suppliers relevant to your specific request, solely to prepare an accurate quotation, and with service providers who help us operate this website, such as our email delivery provider, under obligations to protect your information.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: We retain the information you provide for as long as necessary to respond to your inquiry, fulfill any resulting engagement, and comply with our legal and accounting obligations, after which it is securely deleted or anonymized.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This website uses only the cookies necessary for its basic functionality, such as remembering your selected language. See our Cookie Policy for details.

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.body: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect the information you share with us against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of the personal information you have provided to us at any time by contacting us using the details below.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.body: This website is intended for business use and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for legal or operational reasons. The "Last updated" date above indicates when this policy was last revised.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how your information is handled, please contact us at {email} or {phone}.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how GOLTENS GENERAL SUPPLIES uses cookies on this website.

sections.heading: What Are Cookies
sections.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device by your browser. They are widely used to make websites function correctly and to remember your preferences.

sections.heading: How We Use Cookies
sections.body: This website uses only essential and functional cookies required for it to work correctly — such as a cookie that remembers your selected language (English or Arabic) so you don't need to reselect it on every visit. We do not currently use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Managing Cookies
